trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Nothing else unlocks it. The road is about 200 hours: play the story first, then work the 100% checklist, then clean up the rest. The Roadmap tab lays out the order.
steps: Finish the story, Chapters 1 to 5
Reach 100% completion for A Long Road
Clean up side stories and miscellaneous trophies
trophies.sources: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list) · KeenGamer (about 200 hours) · Output Lag (about 200 hours)

Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist; work you did earlier already counts. You do not need everything in the game, only the checklist numbers in the 100% Completion tab: 100 optional tasks, all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 flamingos, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 42 of 42 shooting range golds and 42 of 42 drone trials. This is the longest trophy by far, most of the roughly 200-hour platinum.
steps: Finish the story first
Open the 100% checklist after the credits
Work the robbery numbers, then collectibles, then activities
trophies.sources: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list) · KeenGamer (checklist numbers, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going past 250: 100% completion needs 300 of 397.
steps: Do stunt jumps and flights as you travel
Check Progress, then Stats, for your count
Push to 300 stunts for A Long Road

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. Playing one of each is enough; you do not need to win or finish any of them. Try something new whenever the game offers it and the trophy pops once you have tried all nine.
steps: Try a different activity each time one appears
Check the trophy progress counter after each new activity

trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Two shooting ranges share the 42 challenges between them. Only golds count, and 100% completion needs all 42 too, so there is no shortcut here.
steps: Visit both shooting ranges
Work through every challenge
Replay any challenge below gold until it turns gold
trophies.sources: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list) · KeenGamer (42 gold medals) · Output Lag (two ranges)

trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 Top Fun locations and 42 drone time trials in total; 100% completion needs all 42 trials, not just the 14 wins.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations

Push to 30 wins for A Long Road

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in total. This is the one trophy that can lock you out of the platinum. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept. That balcony meditation disappears once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay. Whether it strictly counts toward the 18 is still unconfirmed, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save. For the other spots, meditation icons show purple when you are close; meditate with both characters at the same spot, each counts, so always bring your partner. 100% completion needs only 15 of 18 meditations, but this trophy needs all 18.
steps: After Down to Earth, check Jason's house in the morning
Follow Lucia to the balcony and accept the meditation
Make a manual save right after
Meditate at every spot with both characters
trophies.sources: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list) · KeenGamer (balcony steps, 18 spots) · Output Lag (balcony steps)

steps: Follow Bret's hunting questline as Jason

Aim for a clean head or heart shot

Get a 4 star Wanted Level
Escape until you leave the red heat zone

trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop.
steps: Call your partner
Rob three shops in a row without the Wanted Level clearing
Wait a moment after the third shop

trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.
steps: Find a group of enemies
Aim and press L3 and R3 for Combat Focus
Take down 5 before Focus ends
trophies.sources: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list) · Output Lag (L3 + R3, assault rifle)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge; planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Board, back out toward the runway and take off; the trophy is delayed, fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, the police come fast.
steps: Save before you go to VCIA
Take a jet at a boarding bridge, gates E3 or E4
Take off and fly about 1 km from the airport
trophies.sources: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list) · KeenGamer · Output Lag (gates E3 and E4)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
steps: Save first
Go to Mile Zero Air Station, south side
Get in a Rhino and drive and fire
trophies.sources: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list) · Output Lag (Mile Zero Air Station)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it; kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs for the Snap Gun
Snap Gun the back door, never kick it
Find the safe code note, open the safe, leave unseen
trophies.sources: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list) · Output Lag (Snap Gun, safe code note)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give you 4 stars at once, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. 100% completion needs all 8 vaults.
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4
Bring your partner to carry the bags
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time
trophies.sources: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list) · KeenGamer · Output Lag (That's Where The Money Is)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
steps: Bring Sticky Bombs to Kingpin Bowling
Take the watch, the shotgun and the safe contents
Escape the police
